Name: Drawberry's Seasonal Cute Characters for SBV
Author: drawberry138
Description:
[b]I do NOT consent to my work being used to train AI or used in AI generation.[/b]

Oh hi!

After many months (thanks for your patience, everyone!), my seasonal cute Sunberry mod is here!

This mod REQUIRES [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry[/url], Content Patcher, and SMAPI. 

I RECOMMEND you download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Poltergeister's Vanilla SCA[/url]﻿ mod for a unified look!
﻿
[b]Installation:[/b]
[list]
[*]download the mod[/*]
[*]drag it into your mods folder and unzip![/*]
[/list][b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]configurable noses[/*]
[*]4 seasonal outfits and Flower Dance outfits for each NPC[/*]
[*]beach outfits where applicable[/*]
[/list]
If you like playing with this mod please consider endorsing it - I’m disabled and bedridden, so any support that can get my work out there helps!

I really hope you enjoy my work! Much love and take care, Drawberry xo

I repeat, DO NOT use my work in AI generation in any shape or form.
